purpose: Reusable organizational support and referral knowledge; no recipient enrollment, endorsement or case-specific participation status.
constraints: A public organizational listing is not consent, verified deliverability, or authority to adjudicate a complaint.
Use only the stated purpose and limitations. Use only email routes explicitly published for the organization; URL-only records are not email destinations.
Community, spiritual and public policy channels receive only appropriate minimal or de-identified inquiries; never allegations about named people or private records.
A confidential intake label does not establish the security of a particular route; verify the official confidential procedure first.
Recheck jurisdiction, eligibility and current contact information before any real submission.
